messages:
kevin: FYI - NewCo wants a tight POC next week. Key asks: SSO (SAML w/ central IdP), SCIM across 3 domains (corp, infra, apps), group->RBAC mapping, delegated admin for tenant ops, and domain ownership proofing. Also asked how SCIM delta scaling affects pricing. Sending their questionnaire: https://docs.google.com/q/abc123

priya: Can we confirm scope first: full bi-directional or inbound-only? That changes SCIM webhooks and rate expectations. I think NewCo wants one-way (IdP -> Redwood) with delta + full fallback.

kevin: Confirmed inbound-only with full fallback. They have multiple AD forests; group membership claims may span ~100k users across domains.

sam: Security Qs I started filling: they want KMS integration (customer-managed key), SAML assertions signed with SHA256, and audit logs retained 1 year. Short answers: KMS via HW-backed keys supported on Private, SAML SHA256 supported, audit retention configurable (enterprise SLA). I'll attach short-answers doc to the RFP.

elena: Tech notes for POC:
- SCIM: recommend delta sync at 1m cadence for delta < 5k changes; plan hourly full sync.
- For >50k group membership churn, enable paging and chunked membership writes (we support groups up to 100k but recommend batching in 5k chunks).
- Domain proofing: DNS TXT + file upload both supported; for multiple domains we can pipeline proofs but need separate validation tasks.

elena: Example SCIM patch for testing:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/1234
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "members", "value": [{"value":"user-5678","display":"a.smith@example.com"}]}
  ]
}
```

jordan: Pricing implication: high SCIM write QPS + large membership churn pushes them to Dedicated. Rough: if they run 1m delta every minute with peak 10k writes/min, estimate 2-3x token-equivalent throughput; price as reserved capacity. I'll draft a delta pricing addendum.

kevin: Can we get an SE-run POC checklist for Tue? Need 30m pre-call with their infra lead and 90m joint session.

priya: SE checklist:
1) Pre-call: confirm IdP metadata and test creds.
2) Provision a POC org on Private/Dedicated preview.
3) Run sample SCIM delta (elena's payload) + show full sync.
4) Validate group->role mapping UI and RBAC flows.
5) Demonstrate domain proofing via DNS TXT.
6) Walk security answers and KMS choices.
7) Capture logs & perf (latency + QPS) and upload to ticket.

sam: Add: capture SAML assertion samples and check replay detection. Request NewCo provide 10 sample assertions for testing.

kevin: Great. I've asked NewCo for IdP metadata and 10 sample assertions. Will post when I have them.

jira-bot: Created ticket INF-7083 with checklist and links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7083

priya: If NewCo insists on customer-managed KMS + HSM for keys, we'll need legal signoff for Private deployment. flagging legal + security. :eyes:

kevin: Noted. I'll loop in legal if they push KMS. Thanks team, will update when I get metadata.
